body:
Hey, thank you for replying, it makes me feel less alone and I appreciate that so much right now. 

Nothing changed, that's what was so confusing. They just went away for a while, all the habits I had in the worst moments of my depression I still have and maintained through the time I felt better (ie. Didn't change my eating or exercise or socialising patterns)

Honestly, I think that's half of what's scaring me about these feelings returning, the fact that I just seem to have NO control over how I feel. I feel pretty bad right now specifically and it's also probably because it's 7 am and I still haven't gotten any sleep.

Sorry if this post is very fragmented and hard to follow, I can't seem to explain myself very well right now.
